item.title: CSMS # 70329550 - ACE Statement Issue
item.description: ACE is experiencing an issue with the generation of daily statements. CBP is working to resolve the issue.

item.title: CSMS # 70290001 - GUIDANCE: Section 232 Duties on Imports of Steel Derivative Articles
item.description: This message provides guidance on Section 232 duties on steel derivative articles under heading 9903.81.91, effective for goods entered on or after November 1, 2026.

item.title: CSMS # 70297705 - ACE Certification Standard Invasive Maintenance Window on October 28, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET
item.description: ACE Certification will be unavailable during the standard invasive maintenance window on October 28, 2026.

item.title: CSMS # 70050970 - Certain Canadian Products Excluded from Importation into the United States; Presidential Proclamations 11061, 11062, and 11063
item.description: Certain products of Canada are excluded from importation into the United States pursuant to Proclamations 11061, 11062 and 11063.
